description: Pre-registered test design: the input domain and how it is sampled, the trade worlds, the literature-backed trait responses, margin floors, seed pools and sample sizes. Frozen and hashed into judge_hash(); changing it invalidates calibration. Rationale and sources: DESIGN_DECISIONS.md.

domain.comment: Every input of Mesa's sugarscape_g1mt, sampled jointly at random (random-search style: each point has a distinct value of every input). Traits are sampled as (min, span) so span 0 (a homogeneous population) is included. Ranges contain the book's settings (vision 1-6, metabolism 1-4, endowment 5-25, N0 400; Epstein & Axtell 1996 ch. II), Mesa's defaults (vision 1-5, metabolism 1-5, endowment 25-50, N0 200) and the vision sweep of Mesa's G1MT tests (vision_max 1-9), and were widened until the pilot map showed both phase boundaries inside the domain: ~10% of the domain collapses (high metabolism, slow regrowth) and ~11% never loses an agent (metabolism fixed at 1). Regrowth >= 4 equals instant growback (cell capacity <= 4). Population and regrowth are log-uniform.

worlds.comment: Every sampled point is run in both worlds (paired), so the trade contrast is estimated within points.

named_points.comment: Fixed points used only for the cheap presence gate (stage 2) and for complexity tracing.

margin_floor.comment: Smallest margins, in units of canonical's typical within-point (seed-to-seed) SD of the statistic over the domain, or in probability units for 0/1 indicators. Margins are max(floor, relative floor x canonical's own response, largest upper confidence bound produced by an innocuous perturbation). l2: root-mean-square discrepancy over the domain. slope: difference in the response to one input across its whole range. contrast: difference in the trade on/off effect. spread: ratio of seed-to-seed spreads (mean absolute difference between seeds). point: per-point shift that counts as a located failure in audits.
margin_floor.spread_comment: The spread test catches gross departures in stochasticity (a deterministic candidate, or one twice as noisy).

diagnostic_comment: Computed and reported but not tested. Design-stage power analysis (canonical against itself on disjoint seeds of the screening bank) showed these heavy-tailed E2 statistics (exactly 0 in the no-death regime, erratic near collapse) were the only ones whose equivalence could not be demonstrated reliably at the affordable sample size. Population relaxation and stability remain tested through the whole trajectory N(t)/N0 (pop_traj) and the plateau.

complexity.comment: A candidate must reduce canonical compressed size by at least max(delta_abs_bytes, delta_rel * parent C).

smoke.comment: Pipeline smoke test only: short runs, small samples and wide margin floors so every code path (including acceptance) is exercised quickly. Not valid for scientific conclusions.
